text_blocks.text: Have you ever been dunked on? I'm not saying it. Yes I have, one time. Well yours doesn't count. Do you remember in Toronto? It actually happened both. text_blocks.text: We were seeing this. Yes. That's when we were out there just dunking on people. Just dunking everything. But there's another player that dunked on me and I was at the, if you're facing the rim, I'm at the left elbow, this player is at the right block. They threw him the ball. I looked, he takes one dribble. I'm looking, I'm trying to be athletic and trying to go get, go get the block just, he wide open, no layups. And as I get there, he kind of like two-hand just and he was a younger guy to me. And the player said to me, many, many years ago, he was like, 'Oh, Kevin Love.' It's who it was. Yeah. Kevin Love.
